title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11551)
clause_1_scope: This Indian standard specifies requirements and methods of sampling and tests for 'E' -glass fibre chopped strand mat, the strands being laid at random and held together with a chemical binder, for the reinforcements of epoxy, phenolic and polyester resin systems in accordance with the mat supplier's instructions.
